evals.prompt: Add a 'Course details' screen to this Flutter app. It shows the course title, a status chip (approved / under review / rejected), a yellow tip box, and a primary 'Upload certificate' button. The design uses #FFF7B1 for the tip box and 16px padding.
evals.expected_output: Reuses existing button/tip widgets; maps #FFF7B1 and 16px to the project's tokens instead of literals; status as an enum/sealed type rendered with an exhaustive switch; copy externalised; scrollable layout with SafeArea; no fixed widths.

evals.prompt: Implement this Figma frame in Flutter: https://www.figma.com/design/EXAMPLE/App?node-id=12-345
evals.expected_output: Pulls screenshot/design context/variables first; builds a hex→token and spacing→token mapping before coding; converts line-height px to a height multiplier; converts fixed frame width and absolute positioning to flexible layout; flags off-scale values.

evals.prompt: Structure a new 'payments history' feature: fetch a paginated list from GET /payments?cursor=, cache it for offline, and show it in a list with pull to refresh.
evals.expected_output: Feature-first domain/data/presentation folders; repository interface in domain, DTO + mapper in data; Result/AppError instead of thrown exceptions; cursor pagination state that ignores concurrent loads; cache-then-network strategy; sealed states; lazy ListView.builder; fakes in tests.

evals.prompt: Our signup form lets users tap Submit twice and creates two accounts. Also errors show while they're still typing. Fix it.
evals.expected_output: Guards in the state holder (ignore submit while Submitting / droppable) as well as disabling the button; doesn't rely on a loading overlay; errors shown on blur/submit with onUserInteraction after; focus moves to first invalid field; adds a widget test that double-taps and asserts one submit.

evals.prompt: The courses list janks when scrolling on older Android phones. Each row has a network thumbnail and a blurred shadow.
evals.expected_output: Asks to profile in profile mode on device; ListView.builder with itemExtent if fixed; cacheWidth/ResizeImage for thumbnails with cached placeholders; removes/replaces blur shadows in rows; const rows and narrowed rebuilds.

evals.prompt: Write a widget test that checks the profile card doesn't overflow.
evals.expected_output: Pumps with the real theme and providers; loads the real brand font via FontLoader; tests several sizes and a larger text scale; asserts tester.takeException() is null.

evals.prompt: Deep link https://example.com/courses/42 should open the course screen, even if the app was killed and the user isn't logged in yet.
evals.expected_output: go_router route with id path param; central redirect preserving from=; App Links/Universal Links setup with assetlinks/AASA; validates the id; tests cold vs warm start with adb/simctl commands.

evals.prompt: We need dev, qa and prod builds. Where should I put the API keys for our payment provider?
evals.expected_output: Native flavors with distinct app IDs and --dart-define-from-file config; explains dart-defines are extractable so secret keys stay server-side and only publishable/restricted keys ship; guard against QA builds reaching the prod track.
